title: Case: Import broker needs the consignee to appoint it before processing
context: The broker has not been appointed. The consignee’s authorised director must complete its stated mandate process before the broker can act.
initial_request: Account register excerpt: Mara Vesk, director, is the authorised signatory for broker appointment on DL-6953. Her verified business-portal channel is active. Please ask her to complete the mandate; our operator account cannot sign it.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-046: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 5 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
